items.title: Al Vollmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 8, 2017
items.q: I picked up Zeke on the east side uptown, Jackie Williams on the west side downtown... I’ve taken the Harlem Blues and Jazz Band like to various parts in the world

ctx.x: So you went to New York.

I picked up Zeke on the east side uptown, Jackie Williams on the west side downtown, and then around the corner pretty much is Joey, then I went up to the Bronx and picked up, actually on the Deegan, he’s off the Deegan and we got back on the Deegan in order to come up here. So it was logical but still, I left the house at 9 and we weren’t on our way until 11:30.

Yeah. And it’s twelve hours later. So this is just — so I sort of I’ve done this kind of thing but I was worried about you guys today. Just hoping okay, the trip goes — then I thought about the fact that you’ve taken the Harlem Blues and Jazz Band like to various parts in the world, so not that this is easy today but compared to the logistics that you have handled over the years, I’m amazed and I appreciate the fact that you do it.
